findings.F1: The failing Calmar of 0.61 comes from one fall: the book dropped 18.5 % over 132 days from a peak in w11 to a trough in w12, both in 2021. 2021 is the book's worst year (summed daily return −0.111), and in that year the cases lost on both sides (de-drifted 48-hour return in the forecast's direction −0.66 % on shorts and −0.83 % on longs).
findings.F2: The coin's 7-day return at the Sunday 23:00 close sorts the cases. When it points the same way as Saturday's move, the cases earn +0.98 % on shorts (t 2.91, 368 cases) and +0.84 % on longs (t 2.85, 488 cases). When it points the other way, they earn +0.19 % (t 0.37, 248 cases) and +0.10 % (t 0.32, 315 cases).
findings.F3: The 7-day condition alone is not the effect. Following the 7-day return on the 48-hour grid without the Saturday signal earns +0.19 % (t 2.46, 7869 cases), about a fifth of what it earns together with the signal. It belongs to the idea's own theory: Saturday's thin-market move continues when it extends the week's move rather than going against it.
findings.F4: Rebuilt with the same costs, the full book has a Calmar of 0.57 and a deepest fall of −19.6 %. Dropping the cases whose 7-day return disagrees raises its Calmar to 0.77 and cuts its deepest fall to −12.5 %, with a Sharpe of 1.04 against 1.06.
findings.F5: By side, long trades summed +927 % (1161 trades) and short trades −320 % (781 trades). A long-only rebuild reaches a Calmar of 0.79 with a deepest fall of −11.4 % (Sharpe 1.02), and the deepest fall stays in w12.
findings.F6: The long side is not just the coin's drift. Being long on every calm Sunday regardless of Saturday's sign earns +0.02 % (t 0.13, 1424 cases), while calm up-Saturday cases earn +0.55 % (t 2.51, 803 cases).
findings.F7: The book's losses are concentrated. The worst 5 % of trades sum to −1418 % against a total of +607 %, the 5 % worst adverse excursion inside the hold is −9.8 %, and trade gain is not graded by |forecast| quintile (+0.45, +0.33, +0.01, +0.40, +0.38 % per trade).
findings.F8: Cost is not the obstacle: the total move per case (+0.65 %) is 3.4 times the 0.19 % cost of a trade, so the failure is in the depth of the falls, not in the gain covering the fee.

ideas.idea: A coin's 24-hour return over Saturday is followed over the next two days, Monday and Tuesday, by a move in the same direction that grows with the size of Saturday's move, while the coin's 30-day volatility of hourly returns is low against its own past year. The continuation is larger the more the coin's 7-day return points the same way as Saturday's move.
ideas.consequence: A trader would follow Saturday's move into Monday and Tuesday in calm markets mainly when the week's move agrees with it, and stand aside when Saturday's move goes against the past week, which cuts the deepest falls.
ideas.name: Saturday continuation with weekly trend

ideas.idea: A coin's rise over Saturday's 24 hours is followed over the next two days, Monday and Tuesday, by a further rise that grows with the size of Saturday's rise, while the coin's 30-day volatility of hourly returns is low against its own past year, and the calmer the coin, the larger the rise.
ideas.consequence: A trader would buy into Monday and Tuesday after an up Saturday in calm markets and take no short after a down Saturday, which keeps most of the gain with a shallower deepest fall.
ideas.name: Calm up-Saturday continues higher
